scripts.check: bun scripts/check-ui-boundary.mjs && bend src/PROOF.bend && bend vendor/bend-ui/PROOF.bend
scripts.test: mkdir -p .build && bend src/Domain.bend -o .build/domain.mjs && bend src/Graph.bend -o .build/graph.mjs && bend src/Edit.bend -o .build/edit.mjs && bend vendor/bend-ui/WORKSPACE.bend -o .build/workspace.mjs && bend vendor/bend-ui/TOKENS.bend -o .build/tokens.mjs && bun test
scripts.pages: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun scripts/prepare-pages.mjs
